title: Degreewise monomorphism from the qcqs single-complex stalk criterion
statement: In a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-base-change], f:X→S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K and K' have quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category], and let φ:L(g')*K→K'. If φ satisfies the canonical localized tensor stalk condition [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], then for every integer n the degree-n cohomology map of the canonical mate followed by Rf'*(φ) [def-pc-derived-base-change-map, def-pc-derived-direct-image] is a monomorphism. This does not assert invertibility of the derived composite.

proof.text: Apply the target-locality reduction with an affine-base criterion still to prove. This uses exact open restriction and compatibility of the canonical map, and introduces no global compactness assumption on S.

For the resulting square with affine bases, infer CompactSpace X from QuasiCompact f and QuasiSeparatedSpace X from QuasiSeparated f. Define P(U) to be IsIso of the explicit canonical source-open comparison. Its affine base case is the source-open affine comparison theorem.
Use affine-adjoining gluing for compact U and affine V with P(U), P(V), P(U∩V). This gives P(U∪V). Apply quasiCompactOpen_induction and compactness of the top open to obtain P(top).
Normalize the top-open comparison to the original global comparison. This completes the affine-base criterion supplied to the target-locality reduction.
Apply the degree-n homology functor to the resulting invertible comparison and retain only its monomorphism property.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJ9; R1 implements target locality, affine base cases, quasi-compact-open induction and top normalization, with only the affine-adjoining gluing step split off to avoid the existing union module’s import cycle. Functorial preservation of isomorphisms gives the homology monomorphism.

from.place: qcqs single-complex comparison in the relatively flat degree-zero base-change argument

lean.statement:
theorem singleComplexBaseChange_homology_mono
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K)
    (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X') (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (h_stalk : SingleComplexBaseChange.StalkCondition f f' g g' sq K K' φ) (n : ℤ) :
    Mono ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) n).map
        (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w K ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map φ))
